input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms mechanic in either direction. Pricing provisions (Section 11 Fees, Section 10 maintenance fees, Section 2 additional-location fees, Section 17 perpetuity conditioned on fee payment) simply refer to the Fee Schedule; searches for "most favoured/favourable", "best price", "other customers", "competitor" and price/rate matching language returned nothing, and the general provisions (Section 20) contain no such covenant. Sparkling therefore has no obligation to extend Garman terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, which is the playbook's preferred position (no MFN burdening the Customer). Nothing to redline; we would of course welcome a Garman-granted MFN in our favour if it can be negotiated.
